Avoid extra round-trips for peers reconstructing blocks without exceeding available TCP window capacity
reviewability: The PR is stacked on #36787 and includes its changes in the diff
agreement: Strong support with multiple test verifications and no blocking objections
Verified by node telemetry and compact block test runs (m4ycon, s00ly)
